pitches.title: Pregnancy danger report comes first on both phones: right advice and 119 for the mother, a pinned alert with 'Telepon ibu' for the Kader
pitches.job: When a mother reports bleeding, waters breaking, fits and so on: the mother goes or calls now, and the Kader calls her within minutes
pitches.outcome: Shorter delay from a danger sign to care (bleeding and pre-eclampsia are the obstetric emergencies a short delay most affects). Measured as the time from report to the Kader's call or first case action, and the share of reports followed by a Puskesmas visit within 24 h.
pitches.evidence: Seen after a 'Perdarahan' report on a private copy of the demo data (port 8123). Mother home: the red card says 'Periksa ke bidan minggu ini' (PregnancyParts.tsx:23 always uses riskHighTip), with no 119 button; 'Tanda bahaya! Segera ke Puskesmas' is the last 'Untuk hari ini' item at y=877 on an 860 px screen (backend maternal.py:173 adds it last; PregnancyHome.tsx:81 does not sort). Kader home: first screen unchanged, the bell has no unread count (KaderHome.tsx:121); Maria is 2nd under 'Ibu hamil', below a KEK-only mother, with no sign, time or call button. The notification 'Segera hubungi' opens /pregnancy/1, which has no 'Telepon ibu' button (the care-team phone row is at y=2071) and repeats 'Periksa ke bidan minggu ini'. Mother's confirmation: 'Kader sudah diberi tahu' (i18n.ts:1643). Screenshots /tmp/arena-ux/20-26.
pitches.smallest_version: (1) RiskCard: when the reasons include a danger sign from the last 3 days, replace the tip with 'Tanda bahaya: segera ke Puskesmas atau telepon 119' and reuse the existing Escalation component (119 and Puskesmas buttons). (2) PregnancyHome: sort p.today by STATUS_RANK, as home.tsx already does, so the danger item comes first. (3) Kader home: a red Card pinned above 'Wilayah saya' for every unread mother_danger notification, showing the mother's name, the sign and the time, with a 'Telepon ibu' danger Button (phone from care_team). Add an unread count on the bell. (4) Kader view of the pregnancy page: the same alert and 'Telepon ibu' at the top. (5) Change the mother's copy to 'Pesan terkirim ke Kader. Jangan menunggu: telepon bidan atau 119 sekarang.' Backend: add the last danger signs and time to the pregnancy detail. The 'Sudah saya hubungi' acknowledgement is a later step.
pitches.risks: The new wording must be checked by the data-ai-engineer against Buku KIA. The pinned card must not also fire for common complaints (use danger=true only). A Kader with several reports needs a short list, not one card each.

pitches.title: Show 'Bawa ke dokter dalam 2 hari' on Beranda: a status pill, the top 'Untuk hari ini' item and a dot on the child picker
pitches.job: Know without digging that a child must see a doctor within 2 days, even when home opens on a sibling or on the pregnancy
pitches.outcome: More doctor_48h children (severe stunting, faltering growth, 2T) are seen within 48 h. Measured as the share of doctor_48h cases followed by a Puskesmas visit or a doctor's note within 48 h.
pitches.evidence: API: Budi has risk_level high, urgency doctor_48h, and the first action code is doctor_48h. The Beranda card shows an orange 'Pertumbuhan perlu diperhatikan' because motherStatus ignores urgency (lib/status.ts:21). /api/children/2/today has no doctor item (backend family.py:27). The ChildPicker has no status mark, and home opens on 'Bunda' (03-mother-home.png). The child page lists 'Bawa ke dokter/Puskesmas dalam 2 hari' about 1.5 screens down, in routine styling and not tappable (AssessmentView.tsx:76; 09-mother-budi-profile-s1.png).
pitches.smallest_version: (1) Backend today_checklist: when the latest triage urgency is doctor_48h, add an 'urgent' item at the top: 'Bawa {nama} ke dokter/Puskesmas dalam 2 hari', with a call action. (2) Home child card: add a second StatusPill for the urgency (ChildCard already has the urgency_ text). (3) ChildPicker: a small status dot plus a screen-reader label on any member whose status is urgent or doctor_48h. (4) AssessmentView: make the doctor row tappable, call the Puskesmas, and use statusColor.urgent.
pitches.risks: Must not frighten the mother: keep the warm headline and add only the step to take. Must not duplicate the emergency Escalation card. The dot must have words for screen readers (colour is never the only signal).

pitches.title: Posyandu day: find and measure any child by name in 2 taps, online or offline
pitches.job: Measure every child who comes to the posyandu, healthy ones included, with no signal, then move straight to the next one
pitches.outcome: More children weighed each month (the share of children aged 0-59 months measured, D/S), which is how faltering growth (2T) and new stunting are caught early. Measured as monthly D/S per village and the median time between measurements on posyandu day.
pitches.evidence: Online: searching 'Adel' returns '🎉 Tidak ada anak yang cocok dengan filter ini', because the search runs inside the default 'Prioritas' filter (KaderHome.tsx:50,64-69). API: filter=priority&q=Adel returns 0 rows, filter=all returns 1 (13-kader-search-adel-priority.png). Offline: search shows 'Tidak bisa terhubung' (16-kader-offline-search-adel.png), although prefetchForOffline saves every child (useApi.ts:85-111) and a saved child opens offline (19-kader-offline-healthy-child.png). 'Ukur anak berikutnya' goes to the priority list at /home (measure.tsx:157,175). The 'measuredToday' text exists in i18n but no screen uses it.
pitches.smallest_version: (1) A typed name always searches all children, whatever segment is chosen. (2) When offline, or when the request fails, filter the saved /api/children list on the phone by name and show it with the 'Offline: menampilkan data tersimpan' notice. (3) 'Ukur anak berikutnya' reopens the list with the search box focused and a '✓ Diukur hari ini' mark on rows measured today (uses the existing measuredToday text). No backend change.
pitches.risks: The saved list can be up to 10 minutes old (prefetch interval). A child registered by another Kader that day will be missing offline: show 'data tersimpan pukul HH:MM'. Demo data marks every child as measured today, so the mark is weak in the demo (to verify with seed dates).

keep.feature: Danger-first symptom check and offline danger screen (119, Puskesmas and Kader buttons first; the report is queued and sent once)
keep.why: The safety rule 'call the Puskesmas or 119 first' already works on these screens (features B13 and D7; danger.tsx:116-129). UX-1 reuses this pattern.

keep.feature: Home opens on the most urgent family member (home.tsx:87-95)
keep.why: It is the right default for a shared phone with several children and a pregnancy. UX-2 adds to it and must not replace it.

keep.feature: 4-step measurement with 'Sudah paham, langsung isi angka' and the impossible-value block
keep.why: It is fast for a Kader and protects data quality (feature B4).

keep.feature: Every child saved on the phone for offline use (useApi.ts prefetchForOffline), and status always shown as a dot plus words (StatusPill)
keep.why: This is the offline base UX-3 depends on, and colour-blind and sunlight-safe status display.
